intro.en: My research focuses on edge intelligence and green edge computing, with an emphasis on joint communication–computation–energy optimization for resource-constrained wireless networks.
intro.zh: 聚焦边缘智能与绿色边缘计算，研究资源受限无线网络中的通信、计算与能量协同优化。

en: I am a Lecturer in the School of Computer Science at Qufu Normal University. I received my Ph.D. in Information and Communication Engineering from Dalian Maritime University in June 2026, supervised by Prof. Rongxi He.

I investigate resource allocation, computation offloading, and federated learning in energy-constrained wireless networks. My current work focuses on maritime and island IoT, with broader interests in extending these approaches to integrated space–air–ground–sea networks.
Before my doctoral studies, I received an M.S. in Biomedical Engineering from Tianjin University and a B.Eng. in Automation from Inner Mongolia University.
zh: 现任曲阜师范大学计算机学院讲师。2026 年 6 月获大连海事大学信息与通信工程博士学位，师从何荣希教授。
研究资源受限无线网络中的资源分配、计算卸载与联邦学习，重点关注能量约束下的海上与海岛物联网，并探索相关方法在空天地海一体化网络中的应用。
此前于天津大学获得生物医学工程硕士学位，于内蒙古大学获得自动化专业学士学位。

text.en: Resource allocation and incentive mechanisms for edge computing and distributed learning, including computation offloading, contribution-aware federated learning, and digital-twin-assisted coordination.
text.zh: 研究边缘计算与分布式学习中的资源分配和激励机制，关注计算卸载、考虑参与方贡献的联邦学习与数字孪生辅助协同。

title.zh: 绿色边缘计算与可持续网络

text.en: Joint communication–computation–energy optimization for renewable-powered edge systems, including energy-aware scheduling and resilient service provisioning.
text.zh: 面向可再生能源供能的边缘系统，研究通信、计算与能量联合优化、能量感知调度及韧性服务保障。

text.en: Cooperative offloading and resource management for maritime and island IoT, with broader interests in satellite–UAV–terrestrial coordination within integrated space–air–ground–sea networks.
text.zh: 以海上与海岛物联网的协同卸载和资源管理为研究基础，进一步探索空天地海一体化网络中的卫星、无人机与地面节点协同。

papers.authors: Z. Wei, R. He, C. Song, X. Chen, and M. Li

summary.en: To account for differences in participants’ contributions, this work uses a Stackelberg game to formulate contribution-aware incentives for clustered federated learning.

summary.en: To coordinate resource use in hierarchical federated learning, this work combines digital-twin assistance with dynamic resource allocation for sustainable IoT systems.

papers.title: Joint Computation Offloading and Resource Allocation in Green MEC-Assisted Software-Defined Island Internet of Things
papers.authors: Z. Wei, R. He, H. Liu, and C. Song

summary.en: To manage energy and computing resources in island IoT, this work jointly optimizes computation offloading and resource allocation within a green, software-defined MEC architecture.
